thread:
kira: Pushing a new iteration of the API Keys page & modal. Goal: reduce accidental leaks and make rotate safer. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/keys-ux-new (frames attached)
dom: Nice. Big UX asks: 1) make secret reveal ephemeral in a bottom drawer (dismisses after 30s) rather than inline so it's less likely to be photographed, 2) offer a one-click 'Download key JSON' with recommended env vars.
olivia: Love ephemeral drawer. For keyboard & a11y, ensure drawer has role="dialog" and traps focus while open. On close, focus should return to the 'Copy secret' button. Also add a live region update: 'Secret displayed. Copy now.'
nate: Rotation flow: after rotate show a 'Grace period' banner: "Both keys active for 48 hours. Test the new key then revoke old." Include a small 'revoke now' action. This reduces accidental downtime when deploying keys.
kira: Good call on 48h. Also proposing permission presets: Compact chips like 'Read vectors', 'Service (gen+chat)', 'Admin' with inline microcopy under each chip. Users can expand to granular toggles.
dom: Empty-state copy for Keys list: instead of "No keys" use: "No API keys yet  create one to start calling the API, or connect an OAuth app. Need least privilege? Try previews." Link to https://redwood.com/docs/keys/scopes subtly.
olivia: Contrast check: the new info banner uses bg #FFF4D9 and text #5C3A00 -> contrast 3.2:1 for small caption. a11y-bot, recommended fix?
a11y-bot: Automated scan: info banner contrast 3.2:1. Recommend darken text to #3D2A00 or increase bg saturation to #FFF0C2 to meet 4.5:1. Also ensure focus outlines are 3px and visible on dark themes.
nate: UX for revoke bulk actions: require typing the word REVOKE in a confirmation modal when >5 keys selected. For 1-4 keys, just show an undoable toast with 30s undo. This balances safety and speed.
kira: For mobile, use a sticky bottom CTA bar for create/rotate with large touch targets; hide the 'last used' column and show it in the row subtitle. Also add a 'dense table' toggle in settings to opt-in to smaller rows.
dom: Security microcopy: when preset includes generation allow, show a subtle billing indicator: 'This preset allows model generation  monitor usage' with a link to set alerts. Also note 'May incur costs.'
olivia: Copy tweak for post-create toast: "Key created. Copy the secret now  it won't be displayed again." Add a small 'Download .json' action and a 'Show again' is disabled.
kira: Developer ergonomics: add a tiny 'Test key' quick-run that executes a sample curl and displays code + simple status. Curl example should be single-line and copyable: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health`.
nate: For the test runner results, surface status (200/401), latency, and a short hint for next steps on failure. Keep logs trimmed to first 300 chars. Ensure results are ARIA-live=polite.
dom: One last nit: rename 'Regenerate' -> 'Rotate' everywhere. And change button tone: rotate should be destructive-style if it immediately revokes old key; since we have grace period use a caution secondary style.
kira: I'll update Figma with ephemeral drawer + 48h banner + presets and add copy variants. Tagging @olivia for a11y acceptance criteria and @nate for revoke UX.
olivia: I'll write the a11y checklist (focus management, live region text, contrast numbers) and attach to PR.
nate: I'll draft acceptance test scenarios for rotate/revoke and the undo flow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
kira: Thanks team — will attach screenshots to PR and add follow-up tickets for docs and telemetry to track test-run usage.
